name: Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge
core_rationale: High western ceramic-bell ridge of Continent 01 where Sola's shield-rim arches hang thousands of hollow terracotta wind-pipes that sing when thermal breezes rise.
local_conflict: Breeze-piping clay sprites and bell-crest finches nest inside the resonant ceramic wind-organs.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Harmonic gale-shear across Flute-Crest Promontory requires the Porcelain Tuning Fork from Ceramic Resonator Crypt.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Carillon ringers say Flute-Crest Promontory hums with a chord so pure it can lift feathered gliders straight into the cloud-layer.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Glazed terracotta arches along the western shield-rim hung with thousands of swaying ceramic bell-pipes.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What wind-organ amphitheater crowns Flute-Crest Promontory?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the western acoustic rim of Continent 01 and connects west to Glaze-Barge Quay.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed terracotta arches hung with thousands of singing ceramic wind-pipes.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m ceramic colonnade walkways, 0.58m wind-organ benches, and 0.14m terracotta risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with sky_kin and construct monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-flute-crest-promontory as a Mystery frontier behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
